projects.title: Self-driving robot
projects.short_description: Autonomous SLAM-based robot equipped with stereo vision for environment mapping and shortest path navigation.
projects.description: The robot uses a stereo camera and real-time SLAM algorithm to perceive its surroundings, build a 2D occupancy map, and localize itself within it. It continuously analyzes the environment to plan and optimize its route toward a target destination, avoiding obstacles and dynamically adjusting its trajectory. The system is designed for modular development.

main.headline: Building robotics, computer vision & full-stack applications
main.bio: Computer Science Engineer from ZUT Szczecin. Specializing in SLAM systems, OpenCV, ZED cameras, CUDA, C#, Python and Avalonia desktop apps. Currently working on autonomous navigation and real-time image processing projects.
